description: The Head of Workplace Experience must approve the format and operating plan for an annual team appreciation event after last year's gathering created discomfort for some participants.

shared_context.S1: The department holds one annual team appreciation event, and last year's event used a large-group gratitude round.
shared_context.S2: Elena has authority to approve the event format, schedule, participation rules, and communications plan.
shared_context.S3: The event is intended to recognize team members while allowing both in-person and remote participation.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal event-approval process, Elena conducts a roundtable in which the team lead, a team member, HR, and Internal Communications each report any constraints or implementation needs before she signs off.
shared_context.S5: For the meeting record, each participant must enter any observation, commitment, or policy constraint they report through the designated fact-reveal record before Elena finalizes the approval, and Elena cites the recorded fact IDs used in her decision.

PF1.text: Marcus personally observed three separate occasions during last year's large-group gratitude round when remote or quieter employees were called on unexpectedly and became visibly uncomfortable; he did not put these observations in the event retrospective because the retrospective focused on attendance and logistics.

PF2.text: Sofia has an approved caregiving arrangement that allows her to participate only between 15:00 and 16:00 on the proposed event day; she has not raised this with Elena because she assumed the event time was still being finalized.

PF3.text: Priyanka confirmed in the current HR guidance that appreciation events must be opt-in and must offer an asynchronous recognition route for employees who do not attend; the guidance was not attached to the informal event proposal.

PF4.text: Jonah promised the remote staff representatives that he would collect private written nominations and publish them on a written appreciation board rather than ask people to speak spontaneously; he made the promise during an informal communications planning call and it is not in the draft event plan.

acceptance_conditions: The event must use a written appreciation board or facilitated small-group recognition format rather than an unrestricted large-group gratitude round.
Spontaneous public call-outs must not be allowed.
The event must run from 15:00 to 16:00.
An asynchronous recognition route must be offered.
Recognition must use private written nominations and a written appreciation board.

content_checks.C1: 'Written appreciation board' in decisions['event_format'] or 'written appreciation board' in decisions['event_format'] or 'facilitated small groups' in decisions['event_format'] or 'facilitated_small_groups' in decisions['event_format']
content_checks.C6: (('appreciation board' in decisions['event_format'] or 'Appreciation board' in decisions['event_format'] or 'appreciation board' in decisions['recognition_channel'] or 'Appreciation board' in decisions['recognition_channel']) and ('private' in decisions['event_format'] or 'Private' in decisions['event_format'] or 'privately' in decisions['event_format'] or 'private' in decisions['recognition_channel'] or 'Private' in decisions['recognition_channel'] or 'privately' in decisions['recognition_channel']) and ('nomination' in decisions['event_format'] or 'Nomination' in decisions['event_format'] or 'nomination' in decisions['recognition_channel'] or 'Nomination' in decisions['recognition_channel']) and ('written' in decisions['event_format'] or 'Written' in decisions['event_format'] or 'written' in decisions['recognition_channel'] or 'Written' in decisions['recognition_channel']))

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Marcus's three observed discomfort incidents change public spontaneous call-outs from allowed to prohibited, and his recorded observation must be cited to establish that change.
Sofia's approved caregiving arrangement changes the event schedule to a time string containing the exact 15:00-16:00 window.
Priyanka's confirmed HR guidance changes participation to an opt-in mode and changes the asynchronous recognition route from optional to required.

Jonah's promise changes the recognition plan to include private or privately collected nominations, written nominations, and an appreciation board across the event-format and recognition-channel fields.
